When the primary button cannot be pressed yet: disable it and show what is still needed above it

Source: R/server.R
kit_run_gate.Rd

Put shiny::uiOutput(ns("ready")) on the page, directly followed by kit_button(ns("run"), ..., "primary", disabled = TRUE) (disabled at first; enabled once the server has checked). The primary button is shown from the start, so people know what they will press at the end of this page.

Usage

kit_run_gate(
  session,
  output,
  missing,
  link = function() NULL,
  button_id = "run",
  output_id = "ready"
)

Arguments

session

The module's session.

output

The module's output.

missing

A reactive: what is still needed (character; length 0 = ready to run).

link

function(): the link after "還差" ("Still needed") (a tag or NULL).

button_id

The primary button's id (the id inside the module, without ns()).

output_id

The uiOutput() id for the "還差" line (the id inside the module).

Value

NULL, invisibly; call it inside the server.

Details

Still check again inside the button's observeEvent(): disabling is only on screen and must not be the only safeguard.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    kit_run_gate(session, output, shiny::reactive(kit_need_files(1L, need = 2L)))
  }
}
